_about: Public-domain Sir Robert Anderson (1841-1918), Assistant Commissioner of the Metropolitan Police and Brethren lay theologian, for the Word Hoard: The Coming Prince (second edition about 1882, and the sixth, 1898), Human Destiny (1886), The Gospel and its Ministry (fifth edition, 1890), Daniel in the Critics' Den (1895), The Silence of God (1897), The Buddha of Christendom (1899) and The Bible and Modern Criticism (fifth edition, 1905), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

randerson-silence-of-god: The Silence of God (New York: Dodd, Mead, 1897)
